excerpt: The motion-quality experiment showed animations at 23 refresh rates from 50 Hz to 165 Hz in 5 Hz steps. Eleven participants performed 600 pairwise comparisons each, producing 6600 comparisons across all participants.
overview: This is the central measurement basis for the paper: it gives the model empirical JND-scaled quality data over the refresh-rate band relevant to high-refresh gaming monitors. It supports claims about diminishing returns, velocity effects, and the need for a model rather than a single critical refresh threshold.
title: 50-165 Hz Quality Sampling
